absent: Full type layouts for folio, vm area, address space, anon vma, stable node, and walk control beyond fields touched here.
Anonymous reverse map walk and file interval iteration and inner address helper behavior.
Lock ordering among anon, file mapping, page table, swap cluster, and XArray exclusion.
Filesystem specific migration callbacks and swap and shmem migration paths.
Large folio split, deferred split queue, and transparent huge page migration support determination.
Reference freeze and unfreeze, expected count calculation, and cache reference accounting primitives.
Swap cache replacement, XArray store under lock, and interrupt control interaction with preemption.
NUMA balancing mode encoding, tiering toptier classification, and last cpuid use.
Memory control group and LRU vector accounting and isolation count semantics.
Translation flush implementation in configurations where the hook is non empty and batched flush coordination.
Movable operations, zone device types, and device private and coherent handling.
Poison handling, writeback completion, dirty tracking, and owner tagging effects.

findings.text: Locked reverse map walk for a folio that dispatches to anonymous handling or file handling according to folio type and declines kernel same page merging folios.
Generic folio migration that requires writeback to be finished and forwards to shared migration helper without private handover payload.

Transfer of reclamation aging NUMA placement and ownership related state from source to destination with clearing of source swap cache and private linkage and with memory control association moved and destination waiters released when writeback related state is present.
Repointing of kernel same page merging stable tracking from old storage to new storage with ordering that makes new location visible before old linkage is cleared.
Copy of every page within a folio to a destination with tolerance for machine check errors during copy and voluntary rescheduling across pages.
Lookup returning a referenced anonymous address space descriptor for a locked mapped anonymous folio or absence when type tag mapping state or lifetime checks fail.
Initiation of migration directed reverse map traversal over all mappings of a folio with a restricted flag set and with special handling for device backed storage and temporary execution mappings.

Callable migration walk entry that validates caller flags skips unsuitable device folios installs an execution temporary mapping filter for anonymous non merging folios and then invokes locked or unlocked traversal.
Callable anonymous descriptor acquisition entry that operates under read copy update protection and revalidates mapped state around reference acquisition.
File backed address derivation assumes caller supplies a non anonymous area and yields the virtual start corresponding to a file offset and length using the area file start as base.

File reverse map traversal covers the page range implied by start offset and count validates folio mapping offset and size consistency cooperates with scheduling skips caller rejected areas and terminates early on per mapping or completion signals.

Migration dispatch requires both source and destination to be locked on entry selects no mapping path inaccessible mapping rejection filesystem specific handling or generic fallback based on mapping state and on success detaches page cache linkage from non anonymous source and refreshes destination cache unless device backed.

Shared migration requires exact expected reference count before doing work aborts on copy failure or mapping exchange failure and only after successful exchange hands over private state and migrates flags.

For folios without cache mapping the exchange removes large remappable folios from deferred split processing under frozen references then transfers index mapping anonymous large statistics and swap backed marking without cache insertion.

For cache mapped folios the exchange freezes references under appropriate exclusion removes deferred split membership transfers index mapping cache reference swap backed swap cache and dirty state replaces cache entry drops old cache reference by partial unfreeze and moves zone and memory control accounting when zones differ.

Stable node migration requires both folios locked and identical mapping association verifies recorded frame matches source updates record to destination frame orders visibility before detaching old association where detachment encodes null stable reference with merging tag.

Fallback migration applies only to clean folios whose private state can be released warns when filesystem provides writeback but no migration handling and distinguishes retryable versus busy outcomes by synchronous mode.

Completion accounting for a source folio adjusts isolated counts according to file versus anonymous classification except for demotion and releases the source reference except for memory failure where release is deferred to poison handling.

File traversal respects caller held exclusion when indicated otherwise acquires mapping read exclusion internally with a nonblocking attempt first reports contention through control when nonblocking is required and releases only internally acquired hold.

Anonymous descriptor lookup samples mapping pointer and acquires a reference entirely within a read copy update read section revalidating mapped state after acquisition to guard against concurrent unmapping and reuse.

Mapping exchange for cached folios holds interrupt excluded cache or swap cluster exclusion across reference freeze deferred split removal and cache replacement keeps interrupts disabled through statistics transfer and only then reenables.

Migration traversal selects the already locked walk variant when caller asserts locked flag and otherwise the variant that acquires exclusion itself while always supplying an anonymous read lock hook to the walk control.
Walk control observed here coordinates per mapping action with opaque argument early completion test area veto test anonymous locking hook optional nonblocking request and contention outcome.

Batch migration organizes folios across input unmapped destination return and split collections and tracks success failure retry split and transparent huge page differentiated counts including page volume.

Batch migration proceeds through repeated unmap attempts followed by a single translation flush barrier followed by repeated move attempts and final undo of leftovers with large folio split retries and distinct outcomes for memory exhaustion retry success and permanent failure.

Single folio migration advances from dispatch to reference validation to content copy to mapping exchange to private and flag handover where failure at validation copy or exchange aborts without later stages.

Large and transparent huge page migration can require splitting when migration support is absent when deferred split membership with partial mapping is observed or when allocation fails with special retry suppression for NUMA misplacement and extended retry for long term pinning.

Migration aborts with retry when reference count exceeds expectation and aborts copy with poison indication when machine check tolerant copy encounters uncorrectable error while fallback aborts busy when dirty or when private state cannot be released.
Translation flush hook is empty in the examined configuration so callers must not assume it performs invalidation by itself and must rely on surrounding unmap and move staging for correctness.
Outcome vocabulary includes EAGAIN for retry, ENOMEM for exhaustion, EBUSY for busy, EOPNOTSUPP for unsupported, EHWPOISON for poison, EFAULT for fault sentinel.

Traversal control vocabulary includes TTU_RMAP_LOCKED and TTU_SPLIT_HUGE_PMD and TTU_SYNC and TTU_BATCH_FLUSH, migration mode distinguishes MIGRATE_ASYNC from MIGRATE_SYNC, reason vocabulary includes MR_NUMA_MISPLACED and MR_LONGTERM_PIN and MR_DEMOTION and MR_MEMORY_FAILURE.

Association tags include FOLIO_MAPPING_ANON and FOLIO_MAPPING_FLAGS and FOLIO_MAPPING_KSM, swap backed and swap cache states are tracked separately, accounting vocabulary includes NR_FILE_PAGES and NR_SHMEM and NR_SHMEM_THPS and NR_SWAPCACHE and NR_FILE_DIRTY and NR_ZONE_WRITE_PENDING and NR_ISOLATED_ANON and MTHP_STAT_NR_ANON.
